FULLMOONKNIGHT-KNIGHT_OATH.title: Full Moon
FULLMOONKNIGHT-KNIGHT_OATH.description:
Draw [blue]{TurnDraw}[/blue] cards each turn and [gold]Retain[/gold] up to [blue]{Keep}[/blue] cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold] at end of turn; both +1 at levels 4 and 7.
At the start of each turn, mix your discard pile into your draw pile.
Your Draw Pile is not reshuffled during a turn.
When your turn-start draw gives you a Curse, draw 1 more card (up to 2 per turn).
[gold]Level[/gold] [blue]{Level}[/blue] (XP [blue]{Xp}[/blue]/[blue]{NextXp}[/blue]): win combats to gain XP; on level up, choose 1 of 3 rewards.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-KNIGHT_OATH.flavor: "By moonlight I swear to keep the town at peace."
SEA_GLASS.FULLMOONKNIGHT-KNIGHT.title: Moon Glass
FULLMOONKNIGHT-KNIGHT_OATH_PLUS.title: Bright Moon
FULLMOONKNIGHT-KNIGHT_OATH_PLUS.descript:
Draw [blue]{TurnDraw}[/blue] cards each turn and [gold]Retain[/gold] up to [blue]{Keep}[/blue] cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold] at end of turn; both +1 at levels 4 and 7.

FULLMOONKNIGHT-KNIGHT_OATH_PLUS.flavor: An ancient touch hardens the oath.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-ANGEL_CODEX.title: Angel Codex
FULLMOONKNIGHT-ANGEL_CODEX.description: Upon pickup, gain [blue]10[/blue] Max HP and [blue]3[/blue] random cards.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-ANTIQUE.title: Antique
FULLMOONKNIGHT-ANTIQUE.flavor: Unappraised, but it still looks usable.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-ASSAULT.title: Assault
FULLMOONKNIGHT-ASSAULT.description: The first Attack you play each combat deals double damage.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-ASSAULT.flavor: Strike first, or not at all.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-BIG_MONEYBAG.title: Big Moneybag
FULLMOONKNIGHT-BLOODLETTING.title: Bloodletting
FULLMOONKNIGHT-BLOODLETTING.description: Duplicate [blue]1[/blue] card in your deck. Max HP -[blue]12[/blue].
FULLMOONKNIGHT-CAMPFIRE_REST.title: Campfire Rest
FULLMOONKNIGHT-CAMPFIRE_REST.description: Whenever you take a card from an Elite or Boss card reward, gain [blue]1[/blue] extra copy.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-CAMPFIRE_REST.flavor: Around a fire, every story gets told twice.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-CAT_GRACE.title: Cat's Grace
FULLMOONKNIGHT-CAT_GRACE.description: Gain [blue]2[/blue] Energy at the start of each combat.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-CHARGE_HORN.title: Charge Horn
FULLMOONKNIGHT-CHEESE_TRAP.title: Cheese Trap
FULLMOONKNIGHT-CHOCOLATE_COFFIN.title: Chocolate Coffin
FULLMOONKNIGHT-CHOCOLATE_COFFIN.descript: Whenever you play an Attack, gain [blue]{Block}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
FULLMOONKNIGHT-CLEAN_SLATE.title: Clean Slate
FULLMOONKNIGHT-COMPETITIVE.title: Competitive
FULLMOONKNIGHT-COMPETITIVE.description: At the start of each turn, add [blue]1[/blue] random [gold]Temporary[/gold] Attack to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
FULLMOONKNIGHT-COMPETITIVE.flavor: Each turn has to top the last.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-COPY_ILLUSION.title: Copy Illusion
FULLMOONKNIGHT-COPY_ILLUSION.description: Upon pickup, duplicate [blue]1[/blue] card in your deck and add [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Slow[/gold] Curses to your deck.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-CRYSTAL_SKULL.title: Crystal Skull
FULLMOONKNIGHT-CRYSTAL_SKULL.description: At the start of each turn, all enemies gain [blue]4[/blue] [gold]Bleed[/gold].
FULLMOONKNIGHT-DEATH_PACT.title: Death Pact
FULLMOONKNIGHT-DEER_SWIFTNESS.title: Deer's Swiftness
FULLMOONKNIGHT-DEER_SWIFTNESS.descriptio: Draw [blue]1[/blue] additional card at the start of combat.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-DEMON_CODEX.title: Demon Codex
FULLMOONKNIGHT-DEMON_CODEX.description: Draw [blue]1[/blue] additional card and gain [blue]1[/blue] less Energy each turn. Upon pickup, lose [blue]8[/blue] Max HP.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-DEMON_CODEX.flavor: Everyone who opened it regretted it. Nobody closed it.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-DEMON_HOURGLASS.title: Demon Hourglass
FULLMOONKNIGHT-DOUBLE_SWORD.title: Double Sword
FULLMOONKNIGHT-DOUBLE_SWORD.description: You deal [blue]1[/blue] additional damage and take [blue]1[/blue] additional damage.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-EAGLE_VIGILANCE.title: Eagle's Vigilance
FULLMOONKNIGHT-EAGLE_VIGILANCE.descripti: At the start of each combat, set [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Composure[/gold] Counter: negate the next enemy action.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-ENDURANCE.title: Endurance
FULLMOONKNIGHT-ENDURANCE.description: Whenever you take damage, [blue]10%[/blue] chance to draw [blue]1[/blue] card.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-EVIL_SACRIFICE.title: Evil Sacrifice
FULLMOONKNIGHT-EVIL_SACRIFICE.descriptio: At the start of your turn, a random enemy loses [blue]2[/blue] HP and you heal [blue]2[/blue] HP.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-FOLLOW_RECIPE.title: Follow the Recipe
FULLMOONKNIGHT-FOLLOW_RECIPE.description: The first Skill you play each combat is copied and shuffled into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
FULLMOONKNIGHT-FORBIDDEN_ENCHANT.title: Forbidden Enchant
FULLMOONKNIGHT-FORBIDDEN_ENCHANT.descrip: At the start of each combat, automatically [gold]Equip[/gold] [blue]2[/blue] random equipment. Draw [blue]1[/blue] fewer card on the first turn of each combat.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-FRENZY_BOOK.title: Frenzy Book
FULLMOONKNIGHT-FRENZY_BOOK.description: Cards in card rewards are [blue]50%[/blue] more likely to be upgraded. At the start of each combat, all enemies gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
FULLMOONKNIGHT-GIFT_CARD.title: Gift Card
FULLMOONKNIGHT-GIFT_CARD.description: The rightmost character card in shops is half price.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-GIGANTIFY.title: Gigantify
FULLMOONKNIGHT-GIGANTIFY.description: The first time you deal [blue]10[/blue] or more damage each combat, that damage is doubled.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-GREEDY_HAND.title: Greedy Hand
FULLMOONKNIGHT-GREEDY_HAND.description: Upon pickup, gain [blue]80[/blue] Gold. Whenever you enter a new act, lose all your Gold.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-GREEDY_HAND.flavor: The tighter the grip, the faster it leaks.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-GUARDIAN_STATUE.title: Guardian Statue
FULLMOONKNIGHT-GUARDIAN_STATUE.descripti: For the first [blue]3[/blue] turns, place [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Counter[/gold] at the start of your turn that negates the enemy's next move.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-HEAVY_CHEST.title: Heavy Chest
FULLMOONKNIGHT-HEAVY_CHEST.description: Draw [blue]1[/blue] additional card each turn. Max HP -[blue]8[/blue].
FULLMOONKNIGHT-HERMIT_POTION.title: Hermit's Potion
FULLMOONKNIGHT-HERMIT_POTION.description: Max HP -[blue]6[/blue]. Afterwards, whenever a card is added to your deck, Max HP +[blue]3[/blue].
FULLMOONKNIGHT-HOURGLASS.title: Hourglass
FULLMOONKNIGHT-IRON_DECISION.title: Iron Decision
FULLMOONKNIGHT-IRON_DECISION.description: Remove up to [blue]2[/blue] cards from your deck.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-JESTER_TRICK.title: Jester's Trick
FULLMOONKNIGHT-JESTER_TRICK.description: Draw [blue]1[/blue] additional card each turn. Upon pickup, add [blue]4[/blue] [gold]Prank[/gold] Curses to your deck.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-JUSTICE_RULING.title: Justice Ruling
FULLMOONKNIGHT-JUSTICE_RULING.descriptio: At the end of each turn, deal damage to a random enemy equal to [blue]20%[/blue] of the damage you have dealt this combat.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-LIFE_PACT.title: Life Pact
FULLMOONKNIGHT-LIFE_PACT.description: At the start of the first turn of each combat, heal [blue]20%[/blue] of your missing HP.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-LUCKY_COIN.title: Lucky Coin
FULLMOONKNIGHT-LUCKY_COIN.description: Gain [blue]1[/blue] Gold on pickup. Dodge the first instance of damage each combat.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-MAGIC_STATUE.title: Magic Statue
FULLMOONKNIGHT-MAGIC_STATUE.description: The first card you play each combat is copied into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
FULLMOONKNIGHT-MASS_PRODUCTION.title: Mass Production
FULLMOONKNIGHT-MASS_PRODUCTION.descripti: After buying [blue]1[/blue] card in a shop, the remaining cards in that shop cost half.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-MINI_SHIELD.title: Mini Shield
FULLMOONKNIGHT-MINI_SHIELD.description: Max HP +[blue]5[/blue]. Gain [blue]{Block}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold] at the start of each combat.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-MORE_MERRIER.title: The More the Merrier
FULLMOONKNIGHT-NUMB.title: Numb
FULLMOONKNIGHT-NUMB.description: Take [blue]1[/blue] less damage from all sources except [gold]Piercing[/gold] damage.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-PHOENIX_FEATHER.title: Phoenix Feather
FULLMOONKNIGHT-PHOENIX_FEATHER.descripti: The next time you would die, revive immediately with [blue]50%[/blue] of your Max HP. Works once.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-PHOENIX_FEATHER.flavor: Still a spark in the ash.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-PIG_BACKPACK.title: Pigskin Backpack
FULLMOONKNIGHT-PIG_BACKPACK.description: At the start of each combat, automatically [gold]Equip[/gold] [blue]2[/blue] random equipment. Gain [blue]1[/blue] less Energy each turn.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-PREPARED.title: Prepared
FULLMOONKNIGHT-PREPARED.description: At the start of each combat, automatically [gold]Equip[/gold] [blue]1[/blue] random equipment.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-RALLY_HORN.title: Rally Horn
FULLMOONKNIGHT-RALLY_HORN.description: Whenever you play a Skill, play [blue]1[/blue] random Attack from your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
FULLMOONKNIGHT-SCORCHING_FLAME.title: Scorching Flame
FULLMOONKNIGHT-SCORCHING_FLAME.descripti: Whenever an enemy acts (including countered actions), it takes [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Fire[/gold] damage.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-SHIP_CANNON.title: Ship Cannon
FULLMOONKNIGHT-SHIP_CANNON.description: Whenever you play an [gold]Equipment[/gold] card, deal [blue]6[/blue] [gold]Fire[/gold] damage to a random enemy.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-SKULL_AMULET.title: Skull Amulet
FULLMOONKNIGHT-SKULL_AMULET.description: Max HP +[blue]5[/blue]. Once per combat, resist an instance of damage greater than [blue]7[/blue].
FULLMOONKNIGHT-SKULL_AMULET.flavor: It took the hit for you.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-SLIGHT_OF_HAND.title: Sleight of Hand
FULLMOONKNIGHT-SLIGHT_OF_HAND.descriptio: At the start of each combat, all enemies gain [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Mischief[/gold].
FULLMOONKNIGHT-SPECIAL_MEDICINE.title: Special Medicine
FULLMOONKNIGHT-SPECIAL_MEDICINE.descript: At the start of Boss combats, add [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Special Medicine[/gold] to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
FULLMOONKNIGHT-SWORD_TRAINING.title: Sword Training
FULLMOONKNIGHT-UNDEAD_FLOWER.title: Undead Flower
FULLMOONKNIGHT-UNDEAD_FLOWER.description: Draw [blue]1[/blue] fewer card each turn. During the enemy turn, whenever an enemy makes you lose HP, deal that much damage to it.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-VAMPIRE_CODEX.title: Vampire Codex
FULLMOONKNIGHT-VAMPIRE_CODEX.description: Heal [blue]1[/blue] HP for every [blue]15[/blue] damage you deal. Max HP -[blue]5[/blue].
FULLMOONKNIGHT-WEAPON_BOOK.title: Weapon Book
FULLMOONKNIGHT-WEAPON_BOOK.description: At the start of each combat, automatically [gold]Equip[/gold] [blue]1[/blue] random equipment. All enemies gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
FULLMOONKNIGHT-WEAPON_MASTER.title: Weapon Master
FULLMOONKNIGHT-WEAPON_MASTER.description: At the start of each combat, automatically [gold]Equip[/gold] [blue]1[/blue] random equipment and shuffle [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Temporary[/gold] copy of it into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
FULLMOONKNIGHT-WILD_FIRE.title: Wild Fire
FULLMOONKNIGHT-WILD_FIRE.description: At the start of each combat, cards in your opening hand cost [blue]1[/blue] less this combat.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-TEMP_COMPOSURE.title: Composure
FULLMOONKNIGHT-TEMP_COMPOSURE.descriptio: Next combat, place [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Counters[/gold] at the start that negate the enemy's first [blue]3[/blue] moves. Gone after that combat.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-TEMP_ENDLESS_MANA.title: Endless Mana
FULLMOONKNIGHT-TEMP_ENDLESS_MANA.descrip: Gain [blue]6[/blue] [gold]Mana[/gold] at the start of the next combat. Gone after that combat.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-TEMP_MANA_BOOST.title: Mana Boost
FULLMOONKNIGHT-TEMP_MANA_BOOST.descripti: Gain [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Mana[/gold] at the start of the next combat. Gone after that combat.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-TEMP_MINI_SHIELD.title: Mini Shield
FULLMOONKNIGHT-TEMP_MINI_SHIELD.descript: Next combat, take [blue]1[/blue] less damage. Gone after that combat.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-TEMP_NATURE_RESISTANCE.de: Next combat, take [blue]25%[/blue] less damage. Gone after that combat.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-TEMP_PIERCING.title: Piercing Damage
FULLMOONKNIGHT-TEMP_PIERCING.description: Next combat, all damage you deal is [gold]Piercing[/gold] damage. Gone after that combat.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-TEMP_POTENTIAL_BURST.desc: On the first turn of the next combat, your Attacks deal double damage. Gone after that combat.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-TEMP_SCORCHING_FLAME.desc: Next combat, whenever an enemy acts (including countered actions), it takes [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Fire[/gold] damage. Gone after that combat.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-TEMP_SKILL_BREAKTHROUGH.d: At the start of next combat, add [blue]1[/blue] upgraded [gold]Temporary[/gold] Ta-ra-ra-pu-ru-ru to your [gold]Hand[/gold]. Gone after that combat.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-TEMP_WAR_HORN.title: War Horn
FULLMOONKNIGHT-TEMP_WAR_HORN.description: Draw [blue]3[/blue] additional cards at the start of the next combat. Gone after that combat.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-TEMP_WOUND_HEALING.title: Wound Healing
FULLMOONKNIGHT-TEMP_WOUND_HEALING.descri: Next combat, heal [blue]10%[/blue] of your missing HP at the start of each turn. Gone after that combat.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-CURSE_BARREN_MOVEMENT.des: Whenever you heal at a rest site, lose [blue]3[/blue] Max HP.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-CURSE_DARK_MOVEMENT.title: Dark Movement
FULLMOONKNIGHT-CURSE_DARK_MOVEMENT.descr: Your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] is not shuffled at the start of combat; it follows your deck order.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-CURSE_GREATER_SLOW.title: Slowed
FULLMOONKNIGHT-CURSE_LESSER_SLOW.title: Slowed
FULLMOONKNIGHT-CURSE_MELANCHOLY_MOVEMENT: [gold]Block[/gold] gained from your cards is reduced by [blue]1[/blue].
FULLMOONKNIGHT-CURSE_PLAGUE_MOVEMENT.des: Upon pickup, add [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Prank[/gold] Curse to your deck.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-CURSE_WITHER_MOVEMENT.des: Prices at merchants, the [gold]Tavern of Forgetting[/gold], the [gold]Witch's Potion Room[/gold] and the [gold]Spring of Life[/gold] are [blue]50%[/blue] higher.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-ADAPT.title: Knight Adaptation
FULLMOONKNIGHT-ADAPT.UNCEASING_TOP: For the Knight, triggers at most [blue]2[/blue] times per turn.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-ADAPT.SHURIKEN: For the Knight, triggers at most [blue]2[/blue] times per turn.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-ADAPT.KUNAI: For the Knight, triggers at most [blue]2[/blue] times per turn.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-ADAPT.ORNAMENTAL_FAN: For the Knight, triggers at most [blue]2[/blue] times per turn.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-ADAPT.MUMMIFIED_HAND: Does not trigger on the Knight's [gold]Equipment[/gold] cards.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-ADAPT.GAME_PIECE: Does not trigger on the Knight's [gold]Equipment[/gold] cards.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-ADAPT.LOST_WISP: Does not trigger on the Knight's [gold]Equipment[/gold] cards.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-ADAPT.BIG_MUSHROOM: The Knight draws a base of [blue]2[/blue] cards on turn 1, so she draws [blue]1[/blue] fewer instead of 2.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-ADAPT.DIAMOND_DIADEM: For the Knight, the threshold is [blue]1[/blue] card played this turn.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-ADAPT.POCKETWATCH: For the Knight, the threshold is [blue]1[/blue] card played last turn, and it draws [blue]2[/blue].
FULLMOONKNIGHT-ADAPT.PAELS_TEARS: For the Knight, gain [blue]1[/blue] Energy next turn.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-ADAPT.PAELS_GROWTH: Copies of the Knight's [gold]Equipment[/gold] do not keep Clone: one more copy per rest instead of doubling.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-SMALL_MONEY_PILE.title: Small Money Pile
FULLMOONKNIGHT-BLOOD_COMPENSATION.title: Blood Compensation
FULLMOONKNIGHT-BLOOD_COMPENSATION.flavor: Demons only take what's on hand.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-SLUGGISH_TRADE.title: Sluggish Trade
FULLMOONKNIGHT-SLUGGISH_TRADE.descriptio: Gain [gold]66[/gold] Gold. Add [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Slow[/gold] to your deck.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-OBSESSION.title: Obsession
FULLMOONKNIGHT-OBSESSION.description: Duplicate [blue]1[/blue] card in your deck. Lose [blue]18[/blue] Max HP.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-OBSESSION.flavor: That card keeps whispering in your ear.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-MEDITATION.title: Meditation
FULLMOONKNIGHT-MEDITATION.description: Duplicate [blue]1[/blue] card in your deck. Lose [blue]1[/blue] Energy per turn.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-MEDITATION.flavor: Only a quiet mind sees clearly.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-MADNESS.title: Madness
FULLMOONKNIGHT-MADNESS.description: Duplicate [blue]1[/blue] card in your deck. Add [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Prank[/gold] to your deck.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-REMORSE.title: Remorse
FULLMOONKNIGHT-REMORSE.description: At the start of your turn, lose HP equal to [blue]10%[/blue] of your Max HP and gain [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
FULLMOONKNIGHT-REMORSE.flavor: The more you regret, the harder you strike.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-CREATIVE_POWER.title: Creative Power
FULLMOONKNIGHT-CREATIVE_POWER.descriptio: Whenever a card is created in combat, deal [blue]3[/blue] damage to a random enemy.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-CREATIVE_POWER.flavor: Every new card comes with a spark.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-FULL_MOON_LEDGER.title: Full Moon Ledger
FULLMOONKNIGHT-FULL_MOON_LEDGER.descript: Keeps track of this run's Full Moon events.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-FULL_MOON_LEDGER.flavor: Apples, Dust, savings: nothing left out.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-ADAPT.KUSARIGAMA: For the Knight, triggers at most [blue]2[/blue] times per turn.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-ADAPT.NUNCHAKU: For the Knight, gives energy every [blue]20[/blue] Attacks.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-ADAPT.IRON_CLUB: For the Knight, draws a card every [blue]6[/blue] cards played.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-ADAPT.THE_ABACUS: The Knight merges her discard pile back every turn; only the merge after she has drawn through her whole deck counts as a shuffle and triggers this.
FULLMOONKNIGHT-ADAPT.BIIIG_HUG: The Knight merges her discard pile back every turn; only the merge after she has drawn through her whole deck counts as a shuffle and triggers this.
